m1_metadata_json_injection.mutation: UPDATE artifacts SET metadata_json=<entries pointing outside the catalog>
m1_metadata_json_injection.expectation: must refuse (the index that was validated must be the index that is served)

m2_length_preserving_slice.expectation: must refuse: the slice bytes are not bound to the source window

m3_entry_path_outside_catalog.mutation: point every index entry path at a byte-identical copy outside the catalog and update the row hash so every validator gate passes
m3_entry_path_outside_catalog.expectation: must refuse (entry paths get the same containment gate)

m5_old_version_deadlock.expectation: the recompute filter and the qualification gate must agree on which generator versions count, otherwise the pipeline deadlocks

m6_newest_invalid_shadows_older_valid.state: newer row failed (created_at 2030), older row completed and qualified
m6_newest_invalid_shadows_older_valid.expectation: build_source_bundle serves the newest VALID row; the query must either match that contract (serve the older usable row) or the divergence must be a signed D-W05 decision

m2b_slice_hash_recomputed.mutation: rewrite the slice with equal-length text AND recompute the index hash
m2b_slice_hash_recomputed.expectation: must refuse (the slice is not a window of the document source)

m2c_hash_field_omitted.mutation: equal-length rewrite with the index content_sha256 keys removed
m2c_hash_field_omitted.expectation: must refuse (no self-recorded hash may disable the binding)

m3b_inside_catalog_outside_derived.mutation: entry paths point at <catalog>/planted/* (inside the catalog, outside derived/), row hash updated
m3b_inside_catalog_outside_derived.expectation: must refuse: slices live under derived/

m4_outside_existing.mutation: entry paths outside the roots pointing at files that EXIST

m4b_outside_and_missing.mutation: entry paths outside the roots pointing at a NON-existent file
m4b_outside_and_missing.expectation: must return the containment code, never sections_file_missing (otherwise the refusal is an existence oracle)

m7_metadata_uncompared_keys.expectation: must refuse (metadata must not contradict the index on ANY key)
